description: The autonomy.list happy path (S56 T6): the grants under one root in the closed polarity the caller named. Each view carries the daemon-rendered describe sentence (AL17's one formatter — no client re-words it) and the honest expiry: expiresAt null means no expiry, never a far-future sentinel. includeInactive is the only way a revoked row is listed; a list that silently dropped revoked grants would read as authority that is not there.
